descr: me preguntaron si pensaban las gafas

descr_english: They asked me whether the glasses were heavy.
future_use_english: I lent them the glasses so that they could try them on and experience their weight.

descr: La mesa del interior del local empezó a hacerme señas de qué era lo que llevaba
descr_english: The people sitting at the table inside the venue started gesturing to ask what I was wearing.

descr: estaba en el metro, y la gente insistía en cederme el asiento (3 personas distintas me han ofrecido el asiento)
descr_english: I was on the metro, and people kept insisting on giving me their seat (three different people offered me a seat).

descr: Esperando al ascensor, la mujer y la hija del portero me han preguntado sobre las gafas y en qué consistía el estudio.
descr_english: While waiting for the lift, the doorman’s wife and daughter asked me about the glasses and what the study was about.

descr: todos los compañeros de trabajo alucinaron al verme, también muchas risas al verme

descr_english: All my work colleagues were amazed when they saw me, and there was also a lot of laughter when they saw me.
future_use_english: They tried on the glasses to see what it felt like to wear them.

descr: un compañero vaciló a una clienta haciéndole creer que con las gafas, se podía ver a la gente desnuda. la clienta pidió probar las gafas de inmediato
descr_english: A colleague joked with a customer by making her believe that with the glasses you could see people naked. The customer immediately asked to try the glasses on.
